subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the umbrella tracker for multi-agent reliability, or should maintainers close it only after promoting the focused session/subagent issues as the canonical remaining work?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the unresolved scope spans product ownership and several open focused items, so automation should not decide the umbrella/cluster policy alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella until focused fixes land
options.body: Leave #43367 open and use #86540 plus the linked focused issues as the implementation path until live proof shows the umbrella behavior is fixed end to end.

options.title: Split and close umbrella
options.body: Designate the focused issues as canonical, comment the split on #43367, and close it only after maintainers agree the umbrella no longer adds tracking value.

options.title: Close as partially addressed
options.body: Close #43367 based on current-main mitigations while accepting that remaining reports must continue only in newer focused issues.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until focused fixes land
recommendation.body: Leave #43367 open and use #86540 plus the linked focused issues as the implementation path until live proof shows the umbrella behavior is fixed end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is mostly agent/runtime product ownership and issue-cluster policy across subagent, gateway, and session-lock surfaces.
